title: Choose the four-domain shape
statement:
What is the molecular geometry of H₂S in the VSEPR model?

[_]{a}

explanations: AX₂E₂ has four domains but two bonded neighbors.
The bonded directions are separated by far less than 180°.
This is the parent domain geometry.
That shape has three bonded neighbors.

hints: Two single bonds leave two lone pairs.
Name the shape using only the two bonded hydrogens.
solution: Sulfur has six valence electrons. Two single bonds leave two lone pairs. Name the shape using only the two bonded hydrogens. AX₂E₂ has four domains but two bonded neighbors.
